title: OpenEPCIS extension (permissive): carrier
description: Permissive capture schema for the https://ref.openepcis.org/extensions/common/carrier/ extension. Declares known terms as optional and allows additional properties, so events that declare GS1-Extensions carrier=https://ref.openepcis.org/extensions/common/carrier/ validate and capture. Generated from the module ontology plus its JSON-LD context; tighten per ontology for field-level validation.

authProfile.x-access-level-rationale: The profile describes the tag's file settings; needed by the verifier, not by the public.

carrier:authProfile.x-access-level-rationale: The profile describes the tag's file settings; needed by the verifier, not by the public.

authStatus.x-access-level-rationale: The verdict is the answer the scanner receives; it reveals nothing about keys or the chip.

carrier:authStatus.x-access-level-rationale: The verdict is the answer the scanner receives; it reveals nothing about keys or the chip.

readCounter.x-access-level-rationale: The read counter is a per-item scan history; for an owner with sales data it can become personal data of the buyer.

carrier:readCounter.x-access-level-rationale: The read counter is a per-item scan history; for an owner with sales data it can become personal data of the buyer.

carrierType.x-access-level-rationale: The carrier product reveals the security level of the label; operational detail of the owner and its labeller.

carrier:carrierType.x-access-level-rationale: The carrier product reveals the security level of the label; operational detail of the owner and its labeller.

diversification.x-access-level-rationale: Part of the authentication profile; key-management detail.

carrier:diversification.x-access-level-rationale: Part of the authentication profile; key-management detail.

keyRef.x-access-level-rationale: The key reference names the owner's wrapping key; harmless alone, but key-management detail.

carrier:keyRef.x-access-level-rationale: The key reference names the owner's wrapping key; harmless alone, but key-management detail.

sdmFileReadKey.x-access-level-rationale: K_SDMFileRead is a secret key; whoever holds it can forge the SUN MAC. Sealed in the event, readable only by the verifier that holds the wrapping key.

carrier:sdmFileReadKey.x-access-level-rationale: K_SDMFileRead is a secret key; whoever holds it can forge the SUN MAC. Sealed in the event, readable only by the verifier that holds the wrapping key.

sdmMetaReadKey.x-access-level-rationale: K_SDMMetaRead is a secret key; whoever holds it can forge PICC data. Sealed in the event, readable only by the verifier that holds the wrapping key.

carrier:sdmMetaReadKey.x-access-level-rationale: K_SDMMetaRead is a secret key; whoever holds it can forge PICC data. Sealed in the event, readable only by the verifier that holds the wrapping key.

uid.x-access-level-rationale: The chip UID identifies the physical carrier; it lets a party track an item across readers and is of use only to the owner, the labeller and the verifier.

carrier:uid.x-access-level-rationale: The chip UID identifies the physical carrier; it lets a party track an item across readers and is of use only to the owner, the labeller and the verifier.
